facts.fact: Madagascar's Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training signed a partnership with Orange Madagascar on 8 October 2026 to develop digital-skills training frameworks and learning pathways for young people and women.

Madagascar's Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training signed a partnership with GIP Pix on 11 September 2026 to prepare young people for, and certify, digital skills, across eight axes including exam centres and trainer training.

Madagascar's Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training and the OIF launched on 19 January 2026 a new phase of D-CLIC to train 1,000 young people free in digital skills by mid-2026, within a goal of 40,000 by 2028.

systems.owner: OIF with Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training

facts.fact: The Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training adopted a UNESCO-backed digitalisation strategy targeting 40,000 people trained in digital skills by 2028, 6,000 a year.
facts.system: National digitalisation strategy of technical and vocational education

facts.fact: The World Bank records DECIM digital-skills sub-component 2.2 (USD 15m) including training of 5,700 people in advanced digital skills and basic digital literacy.

facts.fact: The government launched the first cohort of the free Skills4Job digital-skills programme on 2 October 2025 in Toamasina with 51 participants, to extend progressively to the rest of the country, said the digital development minister.

facts.fact: Minister Delmotte says the ministry is creating Digital Centers in each of six provinces, financed from its budget, with a part for digital-skills training; the first is open at Ivato and Tamatave is to begin construction.
